div.div:
NOTES:
The python script
src/webapps/release.py
generates a list of git commits with commit messages containing JIRA ticket keys for tickets that have been closed since the last release. It takes two arguments: a token that is the value of the
tenant.session.token
cookie in your browser; and a date marking the last release candidate sent to UAT.
The git command
git log release...main --cherry-pick
will show you all the commits on
main
that have not been cherry-picked to
release
.
